profile.ja:
悪鬼彷徨う現の闇を…
払うは月影…我、上弦なり！
想破上弦衆、閃忍ハルカ見参！

異世界において、数百年の時を超えて現代に現れ
強大なる邪悪組織ノロイ党を打ち破った伝説の閃忍。
異世界からの助けを求める声を聴き、今度は次元を超えて
トキサダ達の召喚に応じて馳せ参じた。
悪鬼彷徨う現の闇を…払うは月影、我、上弦なり！
profile.en: They are a legendary Shun-nin who appeared in the modern world after transcending hundreds of years of time in another world, and defeated the powerful evil organization, Noroi Party. They heard the voices seeking help from another world and responded to the summons of Tokisada and others, crossing dimensions. They will dispel the darkness of the present world - the moon's shadow, they are the upper crescent.

text.ja: 悪鬼彷徨う現の闇を、払うは月影。我、上弦なり。想破上弦衆が閃忍、ハルカ、見参！　ふふ、よろしくお願いします
text.en: I'll dispel the darkness of the wandering evil spirits, I am the moon's shadow, the upper crescent. The thought-breaking upper crescent group's Shun-nin, Haruka, has arrived. Hehe, nice to meet you, I'm looking forward to working with you.

text.ja: 一門の当主様でいらっしゃったのですねっ？！　そうとは知らずご無礼を――構わない、のですか？　ふふ、私の知るお方と少し似ておりますね
text.en: You're the master of the household, aren't you? I didn't know that, so I apologize if I was rude - but it's okay, right? You seem a bit like someone I know.

text.ja: はい。私は上弦衆という忍衆のくノ一、忍ですが……閃忍とは何かですか？　あの、それは……申し訳ありません、ご容赦ください
text.en: Yes, I'm a Kunoichi, a ninja from the upper crescent group... but what's a Shun-nin, exactly? I mean, it's... sorry, please forgive me.

text.ja: 龍の者ではないのですね……いえ、龍の者が敵などと、そういうことではなくっ！　ホッとしたのは、ええと、お気になさらないでください！
text.en: You're not a dragon's ally, are you... no, I mean, it's not like I thought you were an enemy or anything. I'm relieved, but please don't mind me.

text.ja: 慣れているわけではありませんが、時や世界を跨ぐのはこれが初めてではありませんから。閃忍として悪しきを討つのみです
text.en: I'm not used to it, but this isn't my first time crossing time and worlds. As a Shun-nin, I just fight against evil.

text.ja: 対魔忍……世界は違えど悪しきを討ち人を守る。同じ志の忍の者がいることは嬉しく、大変心強く思います
text.en: The Taimanin... though we're from different worlds, we share the same goal of defeating evil and protecting people. I'm happy to know there are ninjas with the same aspirations, and it's a great encouragement.

text.ja: ノロイ党を討ち、星の数ほどの戦を経験して参りました。閃忍ハルカのこの力、現の闇を払うためならばどうぞご存分にお使いください
text.en: I've defeated the Noroi Party and experienced countless battles. Please use my power as Shun-nin Haruka to dispel the darkness of the present world as you see fit.

text.ja: やはりあの方との龍輪功がなければ閃忍の力は……それでも閃忍として、ダイビートの一員として、戦い抜いてみせますっ！
text.en: Without that person's Ryūrin technique, my power as a Shun-nin would be... but even so, I'll fight on as a Shun-nin and a member of Daibito.

text.ja: いやあああああっ！！　私からあの方を消さないでっ！　うぅっ、あの、方、って誰……ああ、ダメ、考えられない、イクっ、イカされるぅっ！
text.en: No, don't take that person away from me! Ah, who was that person... no, I won't think about it, I won't.

text.ja: あぁあ～そうですぅ、ハルカは男性様を愛するメス豚、専妊ハルカです。男性様の熱くて逞しい欲望をどうか、ハルカにお恵みください
text.en: Ah, yes, Haruka is a female pig who loves men, a dedicated breeder, Haruka. Please grant me the intense and powerful desires of my master.

text.ja: はあんっ、男性様ぁ、ハルカの奥まで届いておりますぅっ！　ああぁあっ、男性様にご奉仕できて、ハルカは幸せです、愛しておりますっ！
text.en: Ah, my master, you're reaching deep inside me. I'm happy to serve you, and I love you.
